name: 빙결의 여왕 (ice raid queen)
status: ART COMPLETE (not integrated in the game yet)
remaining: integration into the game code (see integrationPlan)
optional: hurt_02 / groggy_02 for 2-frame loops; minion idle/hurt frames
note: ONE giant stationary sprite. Art faces LEFT. All frames share ONE 1x canvas and ONE pivot (ground point = centre of the ice-crystal base). Box coords (1x px, same convention as dragon_fire.json): x = distance IN FRONT of the pivot (positive = facing side, art-left), yTop/yBot = height relative to the ground (negative = up). Box = [x0, x1, yTop, yBot]. Multiply by actorScale (0.55) for world units. Generated on chroma GREEN (not magenta) and keyed with green despill: no purple fringes.

files.frames1x: frames/<anim>_NN.png (full 1x canvas, hard alpha, one 96-colour palette for all frames)
files.raw: sheets_raw/*.png (untouched AI sheets, green bg): 01-05 v1, 06-13 v2 (06 = top half only: blizzard)
files.scripts: scripts/ (v1: prompts, cut, split, place, build, boxes, spec, gifs; v2: split2, scale2, build2, boxes2, preview2)

hdEntry: hd = [w, h, ox, oy, f, fullW, fullH] exactly like assets/hd/manifest.json: crop size, crop offset inside the full HD canvas (1x canvas x 1.1), f = 1.1

hurtKinds.head: full damage (crit)
hurtKinds.body: gown/torso/hair band 60-250 px up: full damage
hurtKinds.base: ice-crystal mound 0-60 px up (what a standing knight reaches): reduced damage (suggest x0.5)
hurtKinds.weak: weak spot, bonus damage (glowing hand in cast_01, head while groggy/down)

idle.note: floating/breathing; code adds bob 1-2px + staff-crystal glow pulse

cast.note: BLIZZARD: 1 = wind-up (glowing hand at the chest = weak spot), 2-3 = arms raised (storm gathers above), 4 = arms swept forward: release the blizzard from castAt. storm art NOT in this sheet (needs fx sheet)

spear.note: ICE SPEAR thrust: 1 = spear drawn back (telegraph ~600ms), 2 = thrust (reach box, chest height -> anti-air). return via idle_01

summon.note: ICICLE RAIN: 1 = staff raised (show red floor circles at the targets), 2 = staff slashes down -> icicles fall/land (fx needed)

roar.note: FREEZING ROAR / enrage (phase change): 3 = scream (radial knockback / freeze from mouth), 4 = enraged stance (bigger crown spikes); hold 4 then back to idle

hurt.note: flinch (only on big hits/break; super armour otherwise). code: white flash

groggy.note: break/groggy: kneeling, head = weak spot (but ~180-260 px up: jump attacks; code may lower the box or add bob)

down.note: collapsed on the floor: head on the ground = weak spot. use as long groggy / defeat pose

shatter.note: death finish: frozen grey-blue ice statue breaking apart. suggested death = hurt_01 -> (white freeze flash) -> shatter_01 + ice-chunk particles, then fade. no hurtboxes

stomp.note: STAFF SLAM / ice-spike stomp: 1 = staff overhead (telegraph), 2 = slam at impactAt (shake + fx spikes row), 3 = hold, 4 = recover -> idle

conjure.note: SUMMON ice wall / minions: 1 = hand forward (telegraph), 2 = staff swept forward -> spawn fx icewall_01 and/or minions on the floor

teleport.note: TELEPORT: 1 = breaking into snow, 2 = snow column (move the actor while hidden, or fade out/in), 3 = reforming, 4 = back (snowflakes) -> idle

death.note: DEATH: 1 = mortal hit, 2 = freezing over, 3 = frozen cracked statue (white flash), 4 = shatter + spawn fx chunk01-09 flying out, then fade. replaces shatter_01

cast_04.note: staff crystal: spawn the blizzard here

spear_02.note: spear thrust at chest height (~210 px up = above a standing knight): only hits jumping players; ground threat must come from an ice-spike fx

summon_01.note: staff raised (telegraph: show floor circles for icicles)

summon_02.note: staff slashes down: icicles land now (fx)

roar_03.note: freezing roar: radial knockback/freeze from the mouth, no damage box

stomp_01.note: wind-up: staff raised overhead (telegraph ~700 ms; show a line of red floor marks in front)

stomp_02.note: staff butt hits the floor here: spawn fx/spikes in a row forward from impactAt (ground threat, standing players must jump)

stomp_03.note: hold while the spike row travels

conjure_01.note: telegraph: hand forward (show floor marks where the wall / minions appear)

conjure_02.note: staff swept forward: spawn icewall / minions on the floor in front

teleport_02.note: mostly a snow column: invulnerable, no hurtboxes

teleport_03.note: reforming at the new spot: invulnerable, no hurtboxes

sheets.06_fxA: top half only: blizzard storm band A + B (tileable). bottom half unused (dirty bg, painterly)
sheets.07_spikes: ground spike eruption 3 stages (small/medium/full) + frozen-floor decal
sheets.08_fxB: ice spear projectile + hit spark / falling icicle + icicle shatter / frost shock ring / 8 death ice chunks
sheets.09_stomp: staff slam 1-4 (wind-up, slam, hold, recover), queen only
sheets.10_summon: conjure 1-2 + ice wall (+ unused front-facing minion, replaced by 13_minion)
sheets.11_teleport: teleport 1-4 (dissolve to snow, column, reform, reappear)
sheets.12_death: death 1-4 (hurt, freezing over, frozen cracked statue, shatter)
sheets.13_minion: ice-spirit minion walk A, walk B, attack, death (drawn facing right, mirrored)

sources.model: gpt_image_2_5 medium 2k 16:9, refs = concept_v1_raw.png + idle crop recomposited on green
sources.model2: sheets 06-12 (2026-11-08): nano_banana_2_1 on Higgsfield, 16:9, refs = concept_v1_raw.png + sheets_raw/01_idle.png; 06 at 4k (3 cr), 07-12 at 2k (2 cr each)

preview.note: preview placement on the ice arena, same as the fire dragon previews

fx.note: effects on their own canvases (1x png hard alpha, shared 64-colour palette; hd webp tight crop, same hd entry format, f = 1.1). pivot = 1x canvas px of the anchor: bottom = ground point (bottom centre), center = centre, tip = spear point (left end), tipdown = icicle point (bottom). Drawn facing LEFT where it matters (spear). Scale already matched to the queen 1x scale; multiply by actorScale 0.55 like the queen.

use.blizzard_01/02: cast_04 storm band: spawn at castAt and travel/tile forward, alternate 01/02 at ~8 fps (ends are cut straight for tiling; seam not perfect, overlap a few px)
use.spikes_01..03: ground spike eruption (stomp row, also usable alone): 01 warning / 02 rising / 03 full (hitbox only on 02-03), then reverse to vanish
use.icefloor_01: slippery floor decal (draw under actors, low alpha optional): slide/low friction zone
use.spear_01 + spark_01: thrown ice spear projectile (fly left from the tip) + hit spark on impact
use.icicle_01 + icicleshatter_01: icicle rain (summon_02): fall onto the red floor circles, shatter on landing
use.frostring_01: freezing roar ring (roar_03 mouth) or stomp shockwave: scale up 0.4 -> 1.6 while fading
use.icewall_01: summoned ice wall (blocks / pushes players), bottom pivot on the floor

minion.name: 얼음 정령 (ice-spirit minion)
minion.note: own canvas, faces LEFT (AI drew it facing right; mirrored in split2.py). pivot = feet (bottom centre). files frames/minion/<anim>.png, hd/minion/<anim>.webp. ~100 px tall at 1x (a bit shorter than a knight).

death.note: then spawn chunk08/09 fx and fade

integrationPlan: Pattern pool (phase 1): blizzard cast, ice spear, icicle rain, staff stomp. Phase 2 after roar/enrage: add conjure (wall + 2 minions) and teleport; shorter telegraphs.

stomp: anim stomp; on stomp_02 spawn a row of spikes fx (spikes_01->03) forward from impactAt every ~45 px (world ~25) with ~80 ms delay per spike; hitbox = spike box 0..70 px up, only while 02/03; standing players must jump. Optional icefloor_01 patches left behind for 4 s (slide).
blizzard (existing cast anim): on cast_04 spawn blizzard band at castAt, travelling forward, alternating blizzard_01/02; damage + slow while inside.
spear (existing): on spear_02 optionally launch spear_01 as a projectile from tip; spark_01 on hit.
icicle rain (existing summon anim): red floor circles on summon_01, icicle_01 falls on summon_02, icicleshatter_01 on landing.
roar (existing): frostring_01 expanding from mouth, knockback/freeze.

conjure: on conjure_02 spawn icewall_01 in front (blocks melee for ~6 s, breakable, breaks into chunks) and/or 2 minions (frames/minion walk/attack/death) that walk to the players; minion HP low, contact/claw damage.

teleport: frames 2-3 invulnerable and hidden; move the queen to the other side of the arena (or same spot with a reposition of players) during frame 2; flip facing if the engine supports it (art faces LEFT).
death: play death 1-4 instead of hurt_01 -> shatter_01; on death_04 spawn chunk01-09 with physics, then fade out. No hurtboxes.
Boxes: new frames use the same box format/convention; teleport_02/03 and death_* have no hurtboxes.
